title: Solids, surfaces, meshes, booleans, sections and large-model performance
objective: Advance the frozen CAD/BIM product from the bounded P009 3D environment into a substantially deeper modeling kernel and viewport layer: richer solid boolean workflows, bounded surface and mesh representations, exact section/slice computation where the existing adapter can support it, deterministic topology-aware semantics where provenance can be reconciled, and large-model performance infrastructure, while preserving the frozen ConstructionOS/CAD architecture and the shared Web/Electron semantic boundary.
acceptance_criteria: P009 camera/UCS/workplane/navigation semantics remain the single shared foundation; no host-specific duplicate 3D math is introduced.
Representative solid workflows support boolean union/intersection/difference through the existing adapter/worker architecture with explicit typed failures and deterministic persisted results.

Surface and mesh representations are introduced only with engine-neutral contracts, explicit ownership/provenance, deterministic serialization, and honest unsupported behavior for operations outside the bounded implementation.

Section/slice computation is upgraded from the P009 bbox foundation to exact adapter-backed geometry where deterministically supportable; unsupported exact sections remain typed failures rather than approximations.
Topology-aware face/edge/vertex selection is added only where canonical mapping and deterministic ordering can be proven; engine GlobalIds remain provenance and never canonical identity.
Web and Electron share semantic model/selection/section/boolean streams and produce equivalent persisted state and deterministic visual artifacts.

Large-model handling includes bounded tessellation, caching/invalidation, progressive viewport update semantics, and measurable performance budgets without moving engine imports across the existing boundary.
All existing CAD-PARITY-002..009 fixtures remain green and byte-identical unless a documented migration is genuinely required and explicitly reviewed.
Save/open/replay, Construction Graph mapping, undo/redo, and provenance remain valid across all new modeling forms.
The exact final implementation head is verified on CI and on a Vercel deployment, including representative boolean/section/topology/performance workflows.
non_goals: Arbitrary freeform NURBS surface editing in one slice.
GPU-specific renderer replacement or mandatory WebGL/three.js adoption.
Unlimited topology/history reconstruction beyond what can be deterministically mapped.
MEP/structural specialized authoring, which remains later scope.
Architecture changes without an explicit ACR.
risk_assumptions: The existing OCCT worker can expose additional boolean/section/topology capabilities without changing the public EngineAdapterBundle semantics.
Reference/dummy behavior may decline advanced operations but must use typed deterministic failure classes rather than fabricate geometry.
Large-model performance work will preserve semantic determinism even where visual delivery is progressive or cached.
Canonical identities remain document-owned; adapter topology identifiers are provenance mappings only.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic unit suites for booleans, sectioning, topology mapping, mesh/surface serialization, cache invalidation, and performance-budget instrumentation.
Web/Electron semantic parity fixtures covering representative solid, boolean, section, topology-selection and large-model workflows.
Real-OCCT coverage through the existing adapter/worker boundary plus explicit reference-engine declines where unsupported.
Regression proof that CAD-PARITY-002..009 fixtures remain green and byte-identical.
Vercel deployed verification of the exact implementation head plus real-browser evidence for the representative 3D workflows.
